vulnerability.description: Constructor allows arbitrary initialization of token for malicious purposes

output_list.recommendation: Consider providing an initialization function that can only be executed once. Initialisation logic can be moved to the constructor

vulnerability.description: EOSToken::transfer() can transfer tokens to an attacker controlled address, attacker has full control over sent tokens

output_list.recommendation: Consider implementing access control on transfer function, such that it can only be executed by certain users

vulnerability.description: EOSToken::transferFrom() does not check if msg.sender has sufficient balance for transfer and does not check if the destination address is not a blacklisted address

output_list.recommendation: The check for blacklist should be added

vulnerability.description: EOSToken::transferFrom() does not check if msg.sender has sufficient balance for transfer and does not check if the destination address is not a blacklisted address

output_list.recommendation: The check for balance should be added

vulnerability.description: EOSToken::decreaseApproval(address spender, uint subtractedValue) can be used for decrease of owner's own balance, owner can spend tokens more than they actually have

output_list.recommendation: Approval for owner owning all tokens should be prohibited
